lens_summary.drift: m9-62 closes the m9-61 follow-up: bounded join restored in stop_probe. Single-commit B-direct; pure refactor; no API change; restores the contract that stop_probe is bounded.

subject.fix: HIGH-5 pattern restored with stop-then-drain semantics: spawn waiter, mpsc::channel, recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)), abandon on timeout with warn! log
subject.issue: Post-m9-61 inline handle.join() had no timeout bound. The previous HIGH-5 pattern (async spawn + recv_timeout(10s)) was lost when switching to inline join.

legacy_findings_preserved.summary: NativeProbeBackend::stop_probe joined probe thread inline without timeout; if wedged, MCP server blocks indefinitely
